acceptance_criteria.criterion: Running the compiled CLI entry point (node dist/index.js) with a valid config.json starts the HTTP server and logs a success message including the port number to stdout.
The staticDir is correctly resolved to the gui/public/ directory relative to the project root using path.resolve(__dirname, '..', 'gui', 'public'), accounting for the compiled JS running from dist/.
Opening http://localhost:<serverPort> in a browser serves index.html and the full GUI application loads.
If the server fails to start (e.g., port in use / EADDRINUSE), an error message is written to stderr and the process exits with code 1.
The existing --verbose flag continues to print configuration details before server startup.
